fullchange: [2.22.2] New: Kiosk mode enabled — HTTP server with customer search, product browsing, walk-in sales. Start from Sale menu or sidebar toggle.
[2.22.2] New: Save as Order button on sale page — create partial bills directly from the standard sale interface. Old Order Register replaced.
[2.22.2] New: Kiosk configuration in General App Settings — set customer selector visibility, product layout, sale mode (order-only/auto-bill), and receipt generation.
[2.22.2] Fix: Bill amount accounting error — recalculateAmounts now uses user-declared sgst/cgst/igst values, handles grouped items, and rounds all totals consistently.

[2.22.2] Fix: Bill Number wastage — BillManager.consume() now matches by both sessionId and billNo, preventing wrong entries from being consumed when numbers are manually selected from available list.
[2.22.2] Fix: SQLITE_BUSY database locked error — added WAL journal mode, busy_timeout=5000ms, IMMEDIATE transaction type, retry on lock errors, and fixed missing await on customer findOrCreate.
[2.22.2] Fix: new-order handler crash guard — window close only attempted when a valid BrowserWindow exists.
[2.22.2] Fix: orders.json missing file handling — new-order gracefully initializes empty file if not present.
[2.22.2] Removed: Spot bill numbering feature and old Order Register window.
[2.22.2] Re-worked Order Manager - Now manage partial bill using Order Manager
